reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is scientifically sound: TiB2 precipitates are known to pin domain walls in magnetic materials, and the proposed processing route (MA-SPS) can produce nanoscale dispersions, though the specific HEA composition and optimal boron content introduce some uncertainty.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and feasible, with a well-defined falsification criterion based on coercivity measurements and TEM characterization, though the statistical significance threshold is not specified.
